name: Coordinate-Block Replacement
definition: For a family $H\subseteq Q_{G\cup\{z\}}$ with sections $B_i=\rho_z^iH$, union $C=B_0\cup B_1$, and a fresh nonempty coordinate block $E$, replace $z$ by $E$ and take $(B_0\times\{0_E\})\cup(B_1\times\{1_E\})\cup(C\times(Q_E\setminus\{0_E,1_E\}))$.
comments: The marked output remembers the new block. A singleton block merely renames the original coordinate.
